conversation.Statement: Internal Revenue Service, Special Investigator Lewis speaking. Can you confirm your identity for this federally recorded call?
Uh, yes, this is Ravi Sharma. I got a message asking me to call urgently about my taxes?
Mr. Sharma, I have your IRS file in front of me. According to our records, there is an outstanding tax liability linked to your Social Security Number from 2021 and 2022, including late penalties.
What? I always pay my taxes on time. Is this a mistake?
This is not a mistake, sir. Our system indicates a discrepancy of $7,486, plus fines and interest for non-payment. If not resolved immediately, federal action will be initiated.
Federal action? Can you please explain? I could lose my work visa over this!

Unfortunately, Mr. Sharma, if this balance is not settled, the IRS is legally obligated to contact Homeland Security regarding your residency status. Additional measures include a lien on all assets, wage garnishment, or even criminal charges.
No, no, please! I can't have any trouble with immigration. What am I supposed to do?
At this point, your only option to halt enforcement is to resolve the outstanding tax debt immediately, before your case escalates to the federal court system.
I don't have that much money in my bank account. Is there a way to pay in installments or something?

Once your file has been flagged for enforcement, the IRS only accepts immediate settlement using secure channels. This includes payment via cryptocurrency, wire transfer, or government-approved prepaid gift cards. Delays will result in an arrest warrant.
Oh my God. Please, I can't be arrested. My family depends on me.
Then you must follow my instructions precisely. How much do you have accessible right now, checking, savings, credit cards?
I think maybe a little over $2,000 in total.
That will be sufficient for an initial payment to prevent the case from being reported to immigration authorities. You need to acquire $2,000 in Apple or Target gift cards within the next 40 minutes.
Gift cards? That doesn't sound like something the IRS does. Are you sure?
Sir, these are federally approved settlement methods for flagged non-citizen accounts. Any hesitation will be noted as non-cooperation and may result in immediate arrest by local law enforcement.
Okay, okay. Where do I get these cards?
You can purchase them at any convenience store, pharmacy, or supermarket. Remain on the line as you do so. Once you have the cards, I will need you to read out each code to verify payment.
Do I need to buy them all at one place?

As long as you reach the $2,000 total, it doesn't matter where you buy them. Time is critical. If we do not receive the codes within the hour, your assets will be frozen and a federal agent may be dispatched to your address.
Alright, I'm leaving for the store now. Please don't report me.
Stay on the line. When you have finished purchasing, inform me immediately. Do not speak to anyone about this case, as your file is under federal investigation and confidentiality is required.
I'm really scared. I've never been in trouble before.

As long as you cooperate fully, we can resolve this quietly. Remember, if you disconnect, enforcement will proceed without further warning. This is your only chance to clear your IRS record and protect your immigration status.
